benchmark: Phase 6.4 Fresh Process Precision Memory & Storage Audit

audit_metadata.execution_model: Independent Isolated Subprocesses (NT CRT Heap Isolation)

root_cause_analysis.previous_working_set_inflation: In earlier runs, FP32, SQ8, and SQ4 benchmarks were executed sequentially within a single process. Freed vector heap blocks were retained by the CRT/NT virtual memory allocator working set rather than returned to the OS kernel, causing working set to report 229 MB -> 272 MB -> 311 MB.
root_cause_analysis.previous_identical_sq4_sq8_owned_memory: reserve(n) unconditionally reserved both quantized_data (12.8 MB) and quantized_data_sq4 (6.4 MB), and get_memory_breakdown() unconditionally summed both capacities (19.2 MB). Resolved by conditioning reserve() on policy flags, shrinking unused buffer in quantize_vectors(), and counting only active quantizer capacity in get_memory_breakdown().
root_cause_analysis.pure_sq8_status: Pure SQ8 achieves 97.70% recall at 41.85 MB owned index memory (56.70 MB process working set), retaining strong accuracy with 46.7% owned memory reduction vs FP32.
root_cause_analysis.pure_sq4_evaluation: Pure SQ4 achieves 6.10 MB vector storage and 35.75 MB owned index memory (49.30 MB working set), saving an additional 6.10 MB owned memory (14.6% reduction vs SQ8), but drops recall to 88.10%. Therefore, Pure SQ8 remains the recommended default compressed configuration.
